Package arena

Class BotInfo

java.lang.Object
arena.BotInfo
public class BotInfo extends Object
This class exists to hold all the important info about a Bot in one place. When Bots are asked for their next move, they get two arrays of BotInfo - one for live Bots and one for dead Bots. No information here is modifiable from outside the arena package, and only the public information about the bots is accessible outside the arena package.
Version:
1.0 (March 3, 2011) Added limited ammo functionality botInfo now contains bulletsLeft which relates ammo level. Corresponds to changes made to BattleBotArena to allow ammo pick up off dead bots and not being able to fire if out of ammo, 2.0 (Nov 15 2015)
Author:
sam.scott, rowbottomn
